g.title: Two ablations stand out
g.desc: Header: two key ablations — keypoint representation and two-stage training

g.data-cue-label: representing element by bounding box with two keypoints beats alternatives
g.title: Bounding box with two keypoints beats the alternatives
g.desc: Keypoint representations: bounding box k=2 beats SME and extreme points by 2.0 Frechet and 7.3 Chamfer mAP
g.text: Figure 3 · Keypoint representations — Bounding Box (k=2), SME (k=3), Extreme (k=4)
Bounding box (k=2) wins — +2.0 Fréchet and +7.3 Chamfer mAP over SME and Extreme.

g.title: Two-stage training: teacher forcing then fine-tuning on predicted keypoints
g.desc: Two-stage training adds about 6.9 mAP for camera and over 8.5 mAP for fusion
g.text: Teacher forcing, then fine-tuning on the model's own
